newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fleming issues buy recommendation on M6.
newsitem.headline: Fleming issues buy recommendation on M6.

text.p: Fleming Securities said it recommends shares in French television station M6-Metropole TV with a price objective of 810 francs in a year's time.
M6 shares were trading at 614 francs at 0924 GMT on Thursday. They set a year high of 634 francs on April 25.
The British stockbroker said in its buy note that M6's advertising revenues growth was outpacing the television sector because the station's market share was growing.
M6's share rose to 12.8 percent in the first six months of 1997 from 12.5 percent last year, and recent audience measurements put its share at 13.6 percent in June, it added.
Advertising revenue at the TV station should grow nine percent in the first half of 1997 and eight percent over the full year, Fleming said.
Programming costs should be contained, rising six percent this year after a 10.6 percent increase in 1996, the stockbroker said.

Television par Satellite (TPS), France's second digital satellite service in which M6 and its parents hold a majority, has also done better than expected, with 160,000 subscribers by the end of June, Fleming said.
